messages:
maria.g: Quick check — onboarding mosaicxl-8b for hosted. weights are at gs://redwood-models/mosaicxl-8b/2026-02-15/weights.tar.gz but validator is failing. Anyone seen tokenizer offset weirdness with this repo? pinging infra for path access.

ben.l: I saw that. Validator error was `vocab_size (50200) != tokenizer.vocab_size (50257)` — likely mismatch between weights and tokenizer files. Are both from same release tag?

sophie: Tokenizer we got from huggingface had a `special_tokens_map.json` with keys remapped. If `pad_token_id` not set, our serving runtime falls back to 0 — causes CLS shifting.

omar: fyi CI bot shows lint error: `config.json: unexpected field 'vocab_file' (deprecated)` — our schema requires `tokenizer.name` or `tokenizer.s3_uri` now.

maria.g: current config snippet (from PR):
```json
"weight_uri": "gs://redwood-models/mosaicxl-8b/weights.tar.gz",
"tokenizer": {"s3_uri": "s3://models/tokenizers/mxl8b/tokenizer.json", "pad_token_id": null}
```
validator output: `Missing required field: tokenizer.vocab_size`

ben.l: quick workaround: set `tokenizer.vocab_size` to 50257 and `pad_token_id` to 1 in PR, but we should source tokenizer metadata rather than hardcoding.

sophie: I can extract tokenizer metadata from the HF repo and upload canonical `tokenizer_meta.json` to s3. Will do this afternoon. will that unblock?

maria.g: :thumbsup: if you can, thanks. Also, can someone check weights checksum? There's a mismatch when runtime tries to map embeddings.

infra-bot: artifact check: weights checksum mismatch for gs://redwood-models/mosaicxl-8b/weights.tar.gz — expected 0a3f..., found 0b4e... Marked as quarantine.

omar: qa: did we change the `special_tokens_map` key name? schema expects `special_tokens` object with `bos`/`eos`/`unk`.

ben.l: PR 234 has a quick fix (https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-configs/pull/234) with validator bump. Tagging @sophie for tokenizer upload. If infra confirms artifact, we can resubmit.

sophie: uploaded tokenizer_meta: s3://models/tokenizers/mxl8b/tokenizer_meta.json. It contains: `{"vocab_size":50257,"pad_token_id":1,"special_tokens":{"bos":0,"eos":2,"unk":3}}`

maria.g: re-running local validator... `PASS` locally. Will push commit to PR. Also adding fallback rule in config: if pad_token_id is null -> use tokenizer_meta.pad_token_id.

omar: note for serving: add an enum mapping in schema for deprecated fields so lint can auto-translate `vocab_file` -> `tokenizer.s3_uri`.

maria.g: thanks all. Action items: ben merge fix to PR when CI green, sophie confirm checksum with infra, omar open small RFC for aliasing rules. I'll schedule a brief canary deploy for dedicated tomorrow. Posting ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-842

ci-bot: CI: model-configs/pr-234 — lint: passed, validator: passed, deploy-staging: queued

ben.l: I'll watch the canary, will also update rollout notes in the console.

maria.g: closing loop: if all goes green tomorrow I'll mark onboarded and update model catalog entry. Thanks :sparkles:
